verdict.rationale: Open WebUI exposes API keys and OpenAI-compatible endpoints (docs-2, docs-19, docs-33, docs-34) so developers can build against it using existing OpenAI-style SDKs, and a gateway API even exposes workspaces as OpenAI-compatible models. However there is no evidence of a dedicated, official Open WebUI SDK package, and a probe for an OpenAPI spec/schema returned 404 across all candidate paths, suggesting no formal machine-readable API contract to build a proper SDK against. Missing for 10: a first-party Open WebUI SDK (Python/JS client library), published OpenAPI/swagger spec, and independent developer corroboration of SDK-based integration.
